_meta.note: Rust item database. Base fields are identical between PC and Console Edition (same underlying item database). DLC-pack and Twitch-drop-only cosmetic items excluded by name (Instruments Pack, Home Deco Pack, Voice Props Pack, Twitch Rivals drops, Abyss skin series, Lunar New Year drops, Krieg pack).
_meta.caveat: No official public manifest of Console Edition's exact final item roster exists. Images are the item's official in-game icon as hosted by corrosionhour.com; items without an image key simply couldn't be automatically matched.
